title: Touchscreen Kaise Kaam Karta Hai? Ungli Nahi, Bijli! 🤔 #shorts
description:
Aapka phone aapki ungli ko nahi, uski bijli ko mehsoos karta hai! Dekho capacitive touchscreen andar se kaise kaam karti hai.
⚡ Screen ke neeche chhupa transparent electrode grid
🔌 Har crossing ek chhota capacitor, lagbhag 2 pF
👆 Ungli field churati hai: 2.0 se 1.7 pF tak gir jaata hai
🔁 Chip poora grid 120 baar per second scan karti hai
🧤 Gloves pehenkar touch kyun nahi chalta
Aise hi electronics explainers ke liye channel subscribe karo! 🔔
